lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi udhaare naanakaa so simare sirajanahaar ||15||
lines.translation: Those whom He saves, meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਇਕਸ ਸਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojee chhod kuvaataRee ikas sau chit laai ||
lines.translation: Forsake duality and the ways of evil; focus your consciousness on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਵਂੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਹਣਿ ਲੁੜੑੰਦੜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaava(n)ee naanakaa vahan luRh(n)daRee jaai ||16||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, O Nanak, the mortals are being washed downstream. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹਟੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tihataRe baajaar saudaa karan vanajaariaa ||
lines.translation: In the markets and bazaars of the three qualities, the merchants make their deals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੜੇ ਪਾਸਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sach vakhar jinee ladiaa se sachaRe paasaar ||17||
lines.translation: Those who load the true merchandise are the true traders. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਥਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)thaa prem na jaanaee bhoolee phirai gavaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not know the way of love are foolish; they wander lost and confused.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਉਦੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਅੰਧੵਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bisaraai kai paude narak a(n)dhyaar ||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, forgetting the Lord, they fall into the deep, dark pit of hell. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੰਮਾਂ ਦੰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa manahu na veesarai maa(n)gai da(n)maa(n) da(n)m ||
lines.translation: In his mind, the mortal does not forget Maya; he begs for more and more wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਮਿ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee naanak nahee kara(n)m ||19||
lines.translation: That God does not even come into his consciousness; O Nanak, it is not in his karma. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਥੁੜਂੀਦੋ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tichar mool na thuRa(n)eedo jichar aap kripaal ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not run out of capital, as long as the Lord Himself is merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਖਰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sabad akhut baabaa naanakaa khaahi kharach dhan maal ||20||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is Guru Nanak's inexhaustible treasure; this wealth and capital never runs out, no matter how much it is spent and consumed. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਭ ਵਿਕਾਂਦੜੇ ਜੇ ਲਹਾਂ ਘਿੰਨਾ ਸਾਵੀ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)bh vikaa(n)daRe je lahaa(n) ghi(n)naa saavee tol ||
lines.translation: If I could find wings for sale, I would buy them with an equal weight of my flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਨਿ ਜੜਾਂਈ ਆਪਣੈ ਲਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਟੋਲਿ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)n jaRaa(n)ee aapanai lahaa(n) s sajan tol ||21||
lines.translation: I would attach them to my body, and seek out and find my Friend. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਦੈ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan sachaa paatisaahu sir saahaa(n) dai saahu ||
lines.translation: My Friend is the True Supreme King, the King over the heads of kings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿਠਿਆ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis paas bahithiaa soheeai sabhanaa(n) daa vesaahu ||22||
lines.translation: Sitting by His side, we are exalted and beautified; He is the Support of all. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gobi(n)d gaaio nahee janam akaarath keen ||
lines.translation: If you do not sing the Praises of the Lord, your life is rendered useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਮੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak har bhaj manaa jih bidh jal kau meen ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; immerse your mind in Him, like the fish in the water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhian siu kaahe rachio nimakh na hohi udaas ||
lines.translation: Why are you engrossed in sin and corruption? You are not detached, even for a moment!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj har manaa parai na jam kee phaas ||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, and you shall not be caught in the noose of death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਇਉ ਹੀ ਗਇਓ ਲੀਓ ਜਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taranaapo iu hee gaio leeo jaraa tan jeet ||
lines.translation: Your youth has passed away like this, and old age has overtaken your body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj har manaa audh jaat hai beet ||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; your life is fleeting away! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: biradh bhaio soojhai nahee kaal pahoochio aan ||
lines.translation: You have become old, and you do not understand that death is overtaking you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਭਜੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak nar baavare kiu na bhajai bhagavaan ||4||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you not remember and meditate on God? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan daaraa sa(n)pat sagal jin apunee kar maan ||
lines.translation: Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: in mai kachh sa(n)gee nahee naanak saachee jaan ||5||
lines.translation: - none of these shall go along with you in the end. O Nanak, know this as true. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit udhaaran bhai haran har anaath ke naath ||
lines.translation: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Master of the masterless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tih jaaneeai sadaa basat tum saath ||6||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, realize and know Him, who is always with you. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਤੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan jih to kau deeo taa(n) siu nehu na keen ||
lines.translation: He has given you your body and wealth, but you are not in love with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak nar baavare ab kiu dolat deen ||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you now shake and tremble so helplessly? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਓ ਅਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੀਕੇ ਧਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan sa(n)pai sukh deeo ar jih neeke dhaam ||
lines.translation: He has given you your body, wealth, property, peace and beautiful mansions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa simarat kaahi na raam ||8||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, mind: why don't you remember the Lord in meditation? ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh daataa raam hai doosar naahin koi ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Giver of all peace and comfort. There is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa tih simarat gat hoi ||9||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, mind: meditating in remembrance on Him, salvation is attained. ||9||
